description: This Java class 'GaugesGrid' is a UI component that manages a grid layout of gauges (or similar UI elements) within a JPanel. It provides methods to initialize the grid and update its layout.

classes.name: GaugesGrid
classes.description: A UI class that creates and manages a grid of gauges using JPanel and GridLayout.

methods.name: GaugesGrid
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the panel with specified number of rows and columns in a grid layout.

methods.name: setLayout
methods.description: Updates the grid layout of the panel with new rows and columns and clears previous components.
